suggested_requirements.text: The system must allow a member of the network to send requests to a particular or all the other members about possible delivery of a driver’s smart card to a similar person.
The system must allow a member of the network to send a bulk request on all or a large part of its driver’s smart card holders to a particular or all members of the network.
The system must allow a member to do statistics on messages issued and received from/to his system.
The system must provide automatic reply to the sender of the request through the use of a standard interface to the Members systems.
The system must track the workflow between senders and related replies.
The system must automatically transmit alert messages to senders/replier/administrator when a constraint on delay for reply is not fulfilled.
The system must allow the administrator to extract statistics of use, standard delay of reply by member/period, and percentage of unsuccessful transactions.
The system must provide the management of user rights and permissions.
The system must be able to define and manage various types of messages related to driver’s smart card holders including pre-delivery check, stolen/lost cards, renewals, exchanges, and duplicates.
The system must be able to include new members in the network through administrative tasks.
The system must provide at application level a full security and encryption policy compatible with the level of security required.
The system must guarantee that no Member of the network, including the administrator, is technically able to re-construct a consolidated European database through the use of the messages exchanged.
The system must allow a Member State to ask for the status of a card to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority of the Member State having issued the card.
The system must allow a Member State to send card status modification requests to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority of the Member State having issued the card.
The system must allow enforcement authorities to ask for driver’s card status to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority of the Member State having issued the card.
The system must allow enforcement authorities to ask for workshop card status to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority of the Member State having issued the card.
The system must guide users through an interface based on end user concepts.
The system must be easy to learn and not obstruct the thematic understanding of the users.
The system must make it easy to correct mistakes.
The system must be designed as a robust and dependable operational system which is tolerant to operator errors and recovers cleanly from power cuts or other disasters.
The system must function reliably with few or no interruptions in its first operational year and fewer still thereafter.
The system must give stable and reproducible results.
The system must be able to establish and keep the dialog with the Members systems despite the various technical environments and technologies used on their sites.
The system will be designed so that background tasks can continue while the user performs foreground tasks.
The system must respond rapidly to user requests irrespective of any background tasks.
The system must ensure acceptable response time of less than 1 minute to enforcement authorities requests.
The system must be maintainable and extensible.
The system must be designed so that it can migrate to upgraded hardware or new versions of the operating systems involved.
The system must be able to migrate to other types of networks than the one proposed by TESTA-II.
The system must provide solutions regarding data encoding problems such as supporting different character sets, name truncation rules, and name matching in case of misspelling.
The system must use the network facilities supplied by the TESTA-II network.
